title: Summary offset
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with Boolean alphabet, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. Define the summary offset to be the work offset of $M$ at $n$, plus three times the product of the machine parameter $k$ and $2s+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
